_doc: pla-02 Grimoire cleanup (director 2026-11-20; owner feedback 1): every keyword and mechanic page opens with its tooltip sentence (the glossary definition) and keeps a detail paragraph only for how-to-play help. Unit-specific exceptions, hidden caps and edge cases live on trait chips or show in the previews. These pages supersede the Grimoire bodies pinned by the tt-01/tt-02/trp-01/pla-01 fixtures. Read by tests/test_short_card_tooltips.py, tests/short_card_tooltips_test.gd, tests/card_panel_text_test.gd, tests/suites/mrk01_marked_suite.gd, tests/suites/dragon_feedback1_suite.gd and tests/suites/tooltip_consistency_suite.gd; the historical fixtures stay untouched.

basic:run: One journey through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon.
Explore rooms, survive fights and claim rewards on the way to each dragon.
basic:map: Choose your route through the section's rooms.
Revealed exits show where you can travel next, and cleared rooms stay open as routes.
basic:loadout: Your gear, magic, items and skills.
Gear, magic and items form your deck. Change them outside combat, including before a battle and at an Ember Hearth.
basic:rewards: After combat, take 1 of 3 cards, or skip to heal 3.
Gained magic cards go straight into your deck; Purge removes one.
basic:relics: Passive effects that last the whole run.
Find them in Relic rooms and win them from dragons and Guardians. Hover relic badges in the top HUD for their current text.
combat:board: Card previews show legal targets, affected tiles and the results before you commit. Enemies show their next attack and the order they act in; red tiles will be struck before your next turn. Press I for every enemy's full plan. Undo move (Z) takes back free Movement until you play a card.
combat:turn_clock: The unit with the lowest Time acts next; you win ties.
The turn order shows the coming turns.
combat:card_plays: Each card you play spends one; they refill each turn, and kills give one more.
The Card Plays counter shows how many you have left this turn.
combat:health_defense: Damage hits Block, then Stoneskin, then Health.
combat:defiance: Each charge turns a lethal hit into 25% Health.
You get 1 charge per 4 permanent levels, refilled at the start of each run.
combat:targeting: Targets must be visible and in Range; ranged attacks need line of sight.
Legal targets light up while you aim.
combat:fatigue: Drawing from an empty pile reshuffles your discard and costs Health.
A Draw card's preview and the Pass forecast show the Health it will cost.
combat:traps: Trigger when entered or attacked, hitting the unit on them and spreading their element around them.
combat:outcrops: Attack one to break it and open a route.
combat:lightning_strikes: Strikes the marked tiles, then leaves them Electrified.
combat:summons: Calls the shown enemy into the fight.
Its intent shows what will arrive, or Summon blocked when nothing can.
combat:umbra: Darkness that hides enemies and their intents.
Light, Vision, Truesight and Dispel Umbra push it back.
keyword:melee: Damage an adjacent target, or one within the shown Range.
keyword:ranged: Damage a target in Range and line of sight.
keyword:move: Walk up to that many tiles.
Pick your own tile to stay.
keyword:blink: Teleport up to that many tiles to a visible open tile.
Pick your own tile to stay.
keyword:block: Absorbs damage until its holder's next turn.
keyword:stoneskin: Absorbs damage after Block; lasts until used up.
keyword:draw: A Draw card's chip shows how many cards will really come.
keyword:card_play: Each card you play spends one; they refill each turn, and kills give one more.
keyword:follow_up: Gain the bonus if you already played a card this turn.
The card's numbers update in your hand while the bonus is active.
keyword:empower: Pay the extra cost as you play this card to gain its bonus.
Charge the card with the Empower seal on its top-right corner (or press E; the right stick on a controller). A charged card glows and stays charged until you play it or your turn ends.
keyword:stagger: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time.
Hover a Stagger target to preview its new place in the turn order.
keyword:illusion: A decoy with that much Health; enemies attack it if it's as close as you.
keyword:immobilize: Can't Move, Blink or Swap during its next turn.
keyword:exhaust: Leaves your deck for the rest of combat.
keyword:retaliate: Until its next turn, whoever hits this unit up close takes that much damage.
keyword:quicken: Your next card this turn costs that much less Time.
The Time badge shows the discount.
keyword:next_attack: Your next attack this turn gains the bonus.
keyword:rite: Its effect lasts the rest of combat and the card Exhausts.
keyword:bleed: Takes that much damage before each move or attack.
keyword:freeze: Skips its next turn and takes triple damage until then.
keyword:shock: On its next turn, it can only Move or Blink.
keyword:expose: Its next damaging hit takes that much more damage.
keyword:sunder: Strips that much Block, then Stoneskin, before damage.
keyword:chain: Jumps to new targets within that many tiles of each hit.
keyword:push: Move the target that many tiles straight away; if blocked, Collision.
When the target is off to a diagonal, Rotate picks which side it goes before you commit.
keyword:pull: Move the target that many tiles straight closer; if blocked, Collision.
When the target is off to a diagonal, Rotate picks which side it comes before you commit.
keyword:collision: A blocked Push or Pull deals 2 damage per tile left, to both units.
keyword:consume: Gone for the rest of the run once used.
keyword:radiance: Cards that push back the Umbra.
keyword:illuminate: Lights tiles within its radius through the Umbra.
keyword:vision: See that many tiles farther for the shown turns.
keyword:truesight: Every enemy counts as visible for the shown turns.
keyword:dispel_umbra: Lower the Umbra by that many stages this combat.
combat:worldspines: Tharokh marks a line of tiles between you and it, and they rise as Outcrops after every second turn of yours.
Break an Outcrop to open a route.
combat:cinder_marks: Marks tiles that take damage and turn to Fire when it lands.
Replace the Fire to deny Crownfire's blast, or lure the dragon into it.
combat:hollow_gale: Strikes everywhere within 2 tiles of Vaeloryx and Pushes struck actors 1 tile.
Escape the outer edge of Eye of the Storm, or step into the eye and face a weaker bite.
combat:area_force: An area force pushes or pulls every enemy within its radius of a center: you, or a tile you choose.
combat:swap: Trade places with a visible enemy or your illusion.
combat:stances: A stance is a rule a card gives you for a while; active stances appear as badges on your character.
combat:cleanse: Remove the listed statuses from yourself.
combat:petrify: Skips its next turn and gains 5 Block.
combat:crystal_armor: Each layer cancels one direct hit.
Cheap hits can clear layers before a heavy strike.
combat:boss_eclipse: Hits anyone outside Light, then plunges the room into Eclipse.
Stand in Light, or walk or Blink onto an unlit brazier to relight it.
keyword:surface: Place the shown ground on the shown tiles.
keyword:surface_fire: Entering deals 2 damage; starting a turn here deals 3.
keyword:surface_electrified: Lightning hits spread across connected Electrified tiles.
keyword:chilled: Takes 2 more damage from attacks; an Ice attack Freezes it.
keyword:detonate: Blow up the chosen ground, hitting everyone on and next to it, you included.
keyword:surface_consume: Remove the shown ground to power this effect.
keyword:surface_relocate: Move a ground tile to another open tile.
keyword:reflect: Attacks from a non-adjacent tile bounce back to the attacker.
keyword:flying: Ignores traps, ground and Collision damage.
keyword:marked: These tiles take the hit on this enemy's next turn.
keyword:charge: At 3 Charge it unleashes Arc Burst; Shock removes 1.
keyword:wind: On its beat, the wind pushes every unit downwind.
keyword:upheaval: On its beat, the marked tiles rise as Outcrops, throwing off whoever stands there.
Break an Outcrop to escape a ring of them.
keyword:burst: When it dies, it hits every unit next to it and leaves Fire.
keyword:time: Spending Time makes your next turn come later.
keyword:eclipse: The darkest Umbra: you see only 1 tile around you.
Light still reveals tiles, and Dispel Umbra lowers it.
keyword:skate: This turn, Ice costs no Movement and doesn't Chill you.
keyword:fireproof: This turn, Fire ground doesn't hurt you.
keyword:surface_convert: Turn the chosen ground into another kind, hitting enemies on it.
keyword:discharge: Remove a connected Electrified network, hitting enemies on and next to it.
keyword:illusion_swap: Swap places with one of your illusions.
keyword:shatter_illusion: Destroy one of your illusions, hitting enemies next to it.
keyword:health: At 0 Health, a unit is defeated.
Your Health carries over between rooms.
keyword:terrain_burst: Hits units around its terrain pieces.
keyword:detonate_cinders: Detonates the Fire on its last Cinder Marks, hitting everyone caught.
keyword:guard_ally: Gives Block to the shown allies.
keyword:ember: Spent on wares and levels; dropped when you die.
Earn them from kills and victories. Recover dropped Embers on your next run.
keyword:element_fire: Fire cards place Fire ground and Detonate it.
keyword:element_ice: Ice cards place Ice and Freeze Chilled targets.
keyword:element_lightning: Lightning cards place Electrified ground and spread through it.
keyword:element_air: Air cards push, pull and move units.
keyword:element_earth: Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and grant Stoneskin.
keyword:skill_point: Earned by leveling; spend them on skills.
Spend them in the Character menu.
keyword:moltshard: Won from your first dragon; trade for Embers or reset your skills.
keyword:wait: Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time to your next turn.
keyword:turns: How many of your turns this effect lasts.
keyword:movement: Tiles you can walk each turn for free.
keyword:item: A one-use card from your item slots.
Equip items in your 2 item slots; each one joins your deck.
combat:surface_techniques: Ground techniques turn the ground under enemies into hits.
combat:sweeping_strikes: Hits every visible enemy that meets the shown condition.
